basic_details.job_title: GeM Senior Assistant Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Government eMarketplace (GeM), a Government Company under the Ministry of Commerce & Industry, Government of India, has invited applications for one post, Senior Assistant Director - States & Union Territories, on a contractual basis. The post is in the Telangana cluster with posting at Hyderabad. Applications go by email to [email protected] with the completed application form and an updated CV on or before 29 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About GeM
content_sections.text: Government eMarketplace (GeM) is a unified digital platform for end-to-end procurement of goods and services by government departments, organizations and public sector undertakings. The notice says GeM began in 2016 and offers a paperless, cashless and contactless ecosystem for government buyers. It is registered as a Government Company under Section 8 of the Companies Act.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible applicants may submit their applications by email to [email protected] . The email must carry two things: the duly completed application form and an updated CV. The notice does not mention a subject line for the email. The Candidate Application Form is Annex I of the notice and is available at the form link given in the notice. Applications without the application form shall not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for one post. Its details are below. Designation: Senior Assistant Director - States & Union Territories, Level E3. Cluster: Telangana. Place of posting: Hyderabad. Type of employment: contractual under the Project Management Unit (PMU) of GeM. Education: Graduate Degree in any discipline from a recognized Institute / University. Preferred: Post Graduate Diploma or Degree with a specialization in Marketing or Operations or Strategy or IT from a recognized Institute / University. Experience (essential): minimum 6 years of total work experience in a business development/sales or similar role. Good to have: strong people and relationship management and leadership skills; capability to work in a fast-paced high growth environment; knowledge of the local language is preferred. Willingness: the individual should be willing to relocate to other locations and be open to extensive travel. The notice does not state the pay for this post. Candidates should refer to the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Contract Terms
content_sections.text: This is a contractual engagement under the Project Management Unit (PMU) for an initial period of 5 years, extendable based on performance and organizational requirements.

content_sections.heading: GeM Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: Responsible for key account management, i.e., handling the most strategic buyer accounts for GeM and building and maintaining strong relationships. Responsible for driving adoption within buyer organizations. Coordinate escalations / support for the buyer organization with the Technical/Operations team. Responsible for growing the account by identifying and addressing untapped opportunities. Oversee the facilitation of the upload of the annual procurement plan by the buyer account. Follow up with the assigned buyers to ensure that all procurement SLAs are met. Any other responsibility as assigned from time to time. Key shared accountability: coordinate with technical and customer experience teams to understand and communicate buyer needs effectively and strengthen the value proposition for the buyer account.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly completed Candidate Application Form (Annex I) Updated CV

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: GeM reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview. Mere fulfilment of the minimum eligibility criteria may not ensure consideration for shortlisting. The GeM selection committee reserves the right to relax or extend the eligibility criteria and educational qualifications.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The crucial date for determining eligibility is the last date of receipt of applications. No applications shall be entertained under any circumstances after the stipulated date. Incomplete applications without the application form shall not be considered. GeM will not entertain any correspondence on shortlisting, and its decisions are final in all matters.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for GeM Senior Assistant Director?
faq.answer: The last date is 29 November 2026. Applications must be submitted by email on or before this date, and none will be entertained after it.

faq.question: Q2. How do I apply for the GeM Senior Assistant Director post?
faq.answer: Email the duly completed application form and an updated CV to [email protected]. The Candidate Application Form is Annex I, available at the form link in the notice.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Graduate Degree in any discipline from a recognized Institute / University is required. A Post Graduate Diploma or Degree specializing in Marketing, Operations, Strategy or IT is preferred.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: The notice requires a minimum of 6 years of total work experience in a business development/sales or similar role. This is listed as essential.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the Senior Assistant Director be posted?
faq.answer: The place of posting is Hyderabad, in the Telangana cluster. The individual should be willing to relocate to other locations and be open to extensive travel.

faq.question: Q6. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, it is a contractual engagement under the Project Management Unit (PMU) of GeM. The initial period is 5 years, extendable based on performance and organizational requirements.

faq.question: Q7. What will the Senior Assistant Director do?
faq.answer: The role covers key account management of strategic buyer accounts, driving adoption within buyer organizations, and following up with buyers so that procurement SLAs are met. It also covers coordinating escalations with the Technical/Operations team and overseeing upload of the annual procurement plan.

faq.question: Q8. Will every applicant who meets the eligibility be called for interview?
faq.answer: Not necessarily. GeM reserves the right to shortlist candidates for interview, and meeting the minimum eligibility criteria may not ensure shortlisting.

faq.question: Q9. Will an application without the form be accepted?
faq.answer: No. Incomplete applications without the application form shall not be considered.
